rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken term for a medication pill.

example.english: Take this pill only after a meal.
example.traditional: 呢粒藥丸要食飯後先食。
example.jyutping: ni1 lap1 joek6 jyun2 jiu3 sik6 faan6 hau6 sin1 sik6

rows.note: Use this when the medication is a flat tablet rather than a rounded pill.

example.english: This pill is too big for me to swallow.
example.traditional: 呢塊藥片太大，我吞唔落。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 joek6 pin2 taai3 daai6 ngo5 tan1 m4 lok6

rows.note: Use this specifically for contraceptive medication rather than an ordinary medication pill.

example.english: Before you take the contraceptive pill, you'd better ask a doctor.
example.traditional: 你食避孕藥之前，最好問下醫生。
example.jyutping: nei5 sik6 bei6 jan6 joek6 zi1 cin4 zeoi3 hou2 man6 haa5 ji1 sang1
